title: Features Fries
tagline: A place where users meet business owners to discuss their product and get rewarded. A decentralized hackathon of suggestions and critics.

prizes.placement: Best use of Blockscout Block Explorer
prizes.title: Best use of Blockscout Block Explorer

description: Users may come on the website and leave their feature suggestions to businesses, even if a business is not officially listed there. They can also upvote other's feature suggestions as well as leave comments. A business may decide to pass a verification process on the platform (based on domain name ownership verification) if it wants and then create an admin space (by paying a small lifetime subscription fee). When it's done, business owners can decide to give incentives to those who get upvotes and leave valuable comments. They do so by creating a rewards pool, with a defined amount and distribution date. Until then, users are free to express their needs to business, and if the feedback is valuable, they get automatically rewarded with the stablecoins from the rewards pool, provided by business. We can say, that it's a big decentralized hackathon of thoughts and critics.
how_its_made:
The rewards pools are fully managed on-chain, except for comments processor, based on openAI. The rewards pool contract is deployed on Morph Holesky chain and is accessible from the backed using QuickNode JSON-RPC provider and Dynamic on the frontend. The deployed contract has pool creation and distribution methods, as well as the subscription management.

When companies want to be verified on the platform and create an admin space, we do so by verifying the ownership of their domain name, using ENS. If the address of the user is the same as the address of the owner of the domain of the business, the he gets the admin abilities, after paying a subscription on-chain.

Features Fries uses Dynamic for the authentication management. Dynamic makes it possible for everyone (even those authentified with email address) to have a DeFi wallet. We make use of these Dynamic-managed accounts to distribute rewards, and keep track of the features suggestions and comments they create. 

We use blockscout as blockchain explorer for Morph. It allows us to get the information about transaction finalities.

The rewards distribution is calculated as an aggregated score of the number of upvotes and comments value, estimated by AI
